chief_complaint: Management of hypertension and associated metabolic risk factors (obesity, prediabetes) with attention to anemia and anxiety.
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 47-year-old male with a history of essential hypertension diagnosed in late 2018, currently treated with hydrochlorothiazide and lisinopril. Blood pressure is modestly controlled (126/84 mmHg) but remains in the stage 1 range. Obesity (BMI ≥30) and prediabetes (A1c 6.2%) were identified in December 2019; no glucose‑lowering or lipid‑lowering agents have been initiated. Anemia was noted in December 2022 without documented work‑up or therapy. Severe panic‑type anxiety emerged in December 2023 and has not been pharmacologically addressed. Social circumstances have shifted, with prior full‑time employment and resolved social isolation now replaced by part‑time work and limited social contact as of early 2025. Recent dental issues were resolved in January 2025. A medication review was flagged in January 2025, indicating potential need to reassess the current regimen.
